Two silver metal rings are visible protruding from the spine area. Several sheets of white paper with colored tabs (white, grey, light blue) are inserted into the binder, sticking out from the right edge.

The metal rings lack realistic specular highlights and mechanical detail. They appear somewhat soft and plasticky rather than metallic, with undefined connection points to the spine mechanism.
The perspective of the binder is slightly inconsistent; the spine curve doesn't perfectly align with the flatness of the cover, suggesting minor geometric warping typical of AI generation.
